title: WordPress Apply: a form mails the typed email, else the account that pressed Apply, never Tracy’s site admin mailbox
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "every published form mails the address the owner gave, the ones a page shows and the ones none does, and nothing else of their mail changes"; "with no mailbox typed, every published form mails the account of the person who pressed Apply, and no page shows it"; "with no mailbox typed and no account mailbox known, no form has its mail changed".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 61).

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): every published Contact Form 7 form's _mail recipient becomes the typed address, else the account email of the person who pressed Apply (shown on no page), and nothing else of its mail changes; with neither known no form's mail is changed.

selectors.sweep: mailTo in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/wp-forms.js; `to: ctx.normalized.email || ctx.email` in wordpress.js

evidence: Ledger L05 (WordPress part), 05/10/2026: with no email typed every Contact Form 7 form kept [_site_admin_email], which on a site Tracy installs is tracy-agent@tracy.ai: a visitor's message reached nobody who runs the business. Red b8ab012fa, fix 295349016; guard of the last case 18ca3d03d.
fence: The account mailbox is a recipient only, shown on no page; a typed email always wins.

tests: every published form mails the address the owner gave, the ones a page shows and the ones none does, and nothing else of their mail changes
with no mailbox typed, every published form mails the account of the person who pressed Apply, and no page shows it
with no mailbox typed and no account mailbox known, no form has its mail changed
